profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Sam's Club

positions.title: Software Engineer - Associate
positions.description: Developing internal web application for Walmart's Total Rewards department to service over 2 million Walmart associates. Modernizing and converting Walmart's mainframe applications to web based applications with RESTful services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired industry leading software development knowledge and best-practices during the software bootcamp phase.
Implemented a web based application used by the COO to monitor batch progression and manage employee credentials.
Created the UI in Angular 4, and services in Spring Data, with Postgres as the database.
CI/CD pipeline was created with the code repository in Gitlab, with a Jenkins web hook, and deployed and hosted by Pivotal Cloud Foundry.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
•	Used Informatica Power Center and observed project life cycle
•	Worked with multiple transformations to manipulate customer data
•	Familiar with writing SQL unions and multi-table joins
•	Identified and resolved performance bottlenecks

certifications.name: Walmart Global Tech GitHub Copilot Champion
certifications.title: Walmart Global Tech GitHub Copilot Champion

volunteerExperiences.description: I observed medical staff in their work environment. I assisted nurses in their duties such as providing water to patients, taking out linens, and checking on patients to make sure their needs were being met.
